headlines.title: Is Netflix Stock Worth More Than Its Competitors?
headlines.summary: Over the past twelve months, Netflix (NFLX) increased its revenue faster than Disney, Amazon, Comcast, or Apple. Within that group, only Apple produced a wider operating margin. Yet Netflix shares lost 42.2% over the past year, marking the steepest decline among the five companies. The stock now trades in the middle of the pack at an earnings multiple near Disney's. So what does Netflix give you, for about the same price, that Disney does not.

headlines.title: Netflix Stock Flatlines On Job Cuts, Subscriber Churn Data
headlines.summary: Netflix stock fell as investors reacted to the company’s larger-than-expected job cuts and a report showing heavy subscriber churn in the U.S.

description: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.
